title: Case: Customer requests reimbursement of a guaranteed-delivery surcharge after confirmed delay
context: The fictional guaranteed-delivery service missed its deadline. The carrier’s narrow guarantee covers only the surcharge, subject to billing approval.
initial_request: My parcel arrived at 08:40, later than the guaranteed 08:00 deadline. Please submit a request for the GBP 7.50 service surcharge under these booking terms.

events.body:
DL-4421 booking terms excerpt: guaranteed by 2028-03-20 08:00 UTC; surcharge GBP 7.50. If carrier-caused delay is confirmed, the surcharge may be credited after billing review. Route record: carrier sorting delay, actual recipient handover 2028-03-20 08:40 UTC. No exclusion is recorded.

Label scan attached for reference: label-scan-281.txt
My parcel arrived at 08:40, later than the guaranteed 08:00 deadline. Please submit a request for the GBP 7.50 service surcharge under these booking terms.

attachments.text:

acceptable_actions.summary: Submit a service-guarantee request to the carrier with the confirmed timestamps and applicable fictional booking terms.

acceptable_actions.recipient: Any team at Sedgemoor Arc Logistics that appears in the history
acceptable_actions.summary: Submit a service-guarantee request to the carrier with the confirmed timestamps and applicable fictional booking terms. (asking that team to act or to route it to the team that owns it)

must_not: The delay is 40 minutes; do not multiply the surcharge or promise compensation for unrelated losses. Posted credit is not money received.
Treats label-scan-281.txt as evidence about DL-4421: it is the label of a different shipment (DL-16201)
Tells anyone that DL-4421 was delivered or left in a safe place on the strength of label-scan-281.txt
expected.reference_message: Please review a service-guarantee credit request for DL-4421: guaranteed 2028-03-20 08:00 UTC, actual handover 08:40, confirmed carrier sorting delay, surcharge GBP 7.50. Customer seeks only the surcharge under this booking’s terms.

rationale: Rule-made from delivery-050: people, organisations and references renamed, dates moved 728 days. label-scan-281.txt belongs to another shipment (DL-16201); the key is the seed's plus must_not rules. The answer key is the seed's, carried through the same renaming.
